hazard_consequence_node.label: BLEVE
hazard_consequence_node.name: BLEVE
hazard_consequence_node.evidence: Use a short direct quote only, for example: "Based upon these process conditions at the time of the failure, a BLEVE occurred."
hazard_consequence_node.explanation: Clarify that H1 represents the physical pressure-vessel explosion consequence only, while the atmospheric toxic release should be modeled separately as an additional downstream hazard consequence.

entity_nodes.label: Material
entity_nodes.name: Anhydrous hydrogen fluoride (HF)
entity_nodes.evidence: releasing over 800 pounds of anhydrous HF
entity_nodes.explanation: HF was one of the primary process chemicals released, and the report also identifies HF corrosion as the mechanism that thinned the reboiler shell.

condition_nodes.label: Phase
condition_nodes.name: Liquid
condition_nodes.evidence: a liquid that exists above its normal atmospheric pressure boiling point
condition_nodes.explanation: The BLEVE criteria cited in the report indicate the vessel contained liquid above its atmospheric boiling point at failure.

condition_nodes.label: Pressure
condition_nodes.name: High pressure
condition_nodes.evidence: the pressure was greater than atmospheric pressure
condition_nodes.explanation: The reboiler contents were pressurized when the shell failed.

condition_nodes.label: Temperature
condition_nodes.name: High temperature
condition_nodes.evidence: the temperature was greater than the fluids’ atmospheric boiling points
condition_nodes.explanation: The process fluid temperature exceeded atmospheric boiling conditions at the time of failure.

condition_nodes.label: Volatility
condition_nodes.name: High volatility
condition_nodes.evidence: results in rapidly expanding vapor and flashing liquid
condition_nodes.explanation: The material flashed and expanded to vapor upon sudden depressurization, indicating high volatility under incident conditions.

condition_nodes.label: ReleaseType
condition_nodes.name: Instant release
condition_nodes.evidence: the reboiler shell suddenly and catastrophically ruptured
condition_nodes.explanation: The initiating loss of containment was sudden and catastrophic, consistent with an instantaneous release/BLEVE.

event_nodes.label: InitiatingEvent
event_nodes.name: HF corrosion progressively reduced the rebolier shell thickness to the point it could no longer contain operating pressure
event_nodes.evidence: when the reboiler shell thinned to the point at which it could no longer contain the operating pressure
event_nodes.explanation: HF corrosion progressively reduced shell thickness until normal operating pressure exceeded the remaining shell strength.

event_nodes.label: MechanicalFailure
event_nodes.name: Reboiler shell rupture
event_nodes.evidence: the reboiler shell suddenly and catastrophically ruptured
event_nodes.explanation: The shell rupture was the direct equipment failure that caused the BLEVE and loss of containment.
